intro: Orokk Omosh is an aging orc blacksmith stationed in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. As the last heir to a storied lineage of smiths, he seeks worthy apprentices across the Horde to preserve his family's armoring secrets before they are lost to time.

p: Standing beside the roaring forges in the Valley of Honor, Orokk Omosh carries a heavy burden: he is the final smith of the venerable Omosh line. Having fathered no children to inherit his craft, Orokk refuses to let his family's hard-won techniques die with him. Instead, he invites capable Horde blacksmiths to undertake demanding trials of metalwork, promising to impart the revered secrets of Omosh armorcraft to those who prove their dedication.

Despite the somber reality of his fading bloodline, Orokk is known among fellow artisans for his boisterous enthusiasm when true mastery is displayed. Completing his trials of craftsmanship earns more than just specialized armoring patterns—it often provokes the famous 'Omosh Dance of Joy,' a jubilant celebration of traditional smithing that echoes through the halls of Orgrimmar.
